target: N8 Output device schedules — variant 2 · On/off events

checked.item: Columns Name / Active / Stations / Days / Events / Actions / Devices
Rows s1–s5 status cells and device counts
Stations | Schedule grid with Week card below
Every day / Per day toggle (both directions)
Timeline rows, legend, tooltips, Holidays row presence
Error on a day tab that is not open
Conflict Alert and its effect on Save
ASK Platform LED schedules table and entries

findings.element: Schedule card · day tabs, when the error is on a tab that isn't open
findings.finding: When the invalid event is on a day tab that isn't open, the only sign is that the tab label turns red; the summary doesn't name the day.
findings.user_impact: The operator presses Save, sees no red field on the open day, and has to scan 8 tab labels for a colour change.
findings.suggested_fix: Name the affected days in the summary, mark erroring tabs without relying on colour, or switch to the first tab with an error when Save fails.

evidence.action: Per day schedule, entered '6' on the Mon tab, went to the Sun tab and pressed Save
evidence.observed: Summary 'Fix 2 fields before saving'; Mon tab color rgb(211,47,47); Sun tab shows no error text

findings.element: Schedule card · Every day toggle on an existing Per day schedule
findings.finding: Switching a Per day schedule to Every day shows an empty list instead of carrying over any events.
findings.user_impact: The operator thinks their events are gone and has to re-enter everything or hits 'Add at least one event'.
findings.suggested_fix: Seed the Every day list from the per-day events, or ask before showing an empty list.

evidence.action: Opened 'Weekend shutdown — Ashkelon', clicked Every day, then Save
evidence.observed: List 'No events.', timeline off segments=0, no confirmation; Save → 'Add at least one event'

findings.finding: When a conflict blocks Save, the summary says 'Fix 1 field', but no field, helper text or tab is marked red.
findings.user_impact: The operator looks for a field to fix and finds none.
findings.suggested_fix: Have the summary state the conflict itself instead of counting it as a field.

evidence.action: With red helpers [] and red tabs [], pressed Save with Akko + Ashkelon
evidence.observed: Summary 'Fix 1 field before saving'; only the conflict Alert 'Conflicts with South line evening at Sun 23:00 on 1 device'

findings.finding: The Week timeline has only Sun–Sat rows, so Holidays events are never shown.
findings.user_impact: No visual check of what a holiday will do.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a Holidays row whenever the schedule has Holidays events.

evidence.action: Opened 'Weekend shutdown — Ashkelon'; built a Per day schedule with Holidays · 2
evidence.observed: Timeline rows sun–sat only; holidays row present=false

findings.finding: Copy to… silently replaces the target days' existing events; the menu gives no sign that a target already has events.
findings.user_impact: Copying can wipe a day's own events without the operator noticing, with no undo.
findings.suggested_fix: Show each target's event count in the menu and say 'Replace' when a target isn't empty.

evidence.action: Sun tab → Copy to… → Sat and Holidays → Copy
evidence.observed: Toast 'Sun copied to Sat, Holidays'; target days replaced, not merged; menu items show day names only

gaps: Leave guard after mode toggle only not recorded
Saving in Every day mode over per-day events never exercised
Loading and empty list states removed
